dedupe_keys.name: generalization to real world road networks

description: This Foshan release combines road-network property workbooks, a trained random-forest pickle, a Python prediction example and resulting link scores. Zenodo lists five public files under CC BY 4.0. The provider says the example predicts critical links using road properties and a recommended mixing proportion; workbooks include precomputed RII, CC and EC values. This model could help rank candidate critical links before a road-network resilience or disruption simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Foshan predictor. A limitation is that the landing page does not define the three abbreviations, training labels, test split, network extent or performance. Pickle files can execute code on load and should be inspected in a controlled environment. A second Zenodo DOI has the same title, description and matching MD5 checksums for all five files; it is treated as a duplicate, not a separate model. Neither code nor pickle was downloaded or executed.
